entities.name: Yoshikazu Kawaguchi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yoshikazu Kawaguchi  was the leading Japanese practitioner of the "natural farming" method popularized by Masanobu Fukuoka and farmed by this method in Sakurai City, Nara Prefecture for 30 years. He was a farmer, author, and founder of the Akame Natural Farming School, or 赤目自然農塾 in Japanese.
